name: Study
description: Review dense material without rereading it: multiple-choice practice, typed and essay tests graded against the text, every question anchored to its page, and only what you missed sent to Flashcards.

commands.title: Mark Question to Come Back To

study.sessionSize.description: Questions per session. Refresh draws the next set from the same scope.

study.questionsPerConcept.description: How many questions of each format a concept needs before generation considers it covered.

study.answerFormat.description: Default answer format for a new session: choose, type, or mixed. Mixed starts on choices and moves a concept to typing once it has been answered right.

study.syllabus.description: What your exam expects: paste the syllabus or learning objectives. Concepts and questions are aimed at it. Empty: questions follow the material alone.

study.aiModel.description: Model id used to write and grade questions. Leave empty to use the chat's active model.

study.generationContext.description: Context window (tokens) for generation and grading. 0 = auto: Study names no size and the app uses the one the model is loaded at, so the model is never loaded again between calls. A fixed value is sent on every call.

study.aiThinking.description: Let reasoning models think before writing or grading. Better questions and fairer grading, at the cost of slower runs. Turn it off only on a machine where generation is too slow.

study.checkAnchor.description: Drop a question whose quote is not on its page.

study.checkSupport.description: Drop a question whose quote, read with its page, does not settle its answer.

study.checkDistractors.description: Drop a multiple-choice question when any wrong option could be defended as correct.

study.checkNumeric.description: Keep a numeric question only when its solution, run in Python, agrees with the stated answer. Needs the workspace Python environment.

study.numericTolerance.description: Relative tolerance for a numeric answer to count as right (0.005 = half a percent).

study.staleDays.description: Days without an answer before a clean concept counts as stale.

study.progressSort.description: The order of the units in a subject's Progress: order (the Units order) or weakest (the lowest share of green first). The switch on the Progress tab sets it.
